tablet.notes:
Swiping follows the order of the bar, and Contacts swipes too. Settings > Screens and the bar > Rearrange the bar: hold a screen and drag it where you want it.
The Message+ menu circle is on every main screen, so Settings is never far. The bar switch now hides the bar on every screen.
Settings > Layout: Display size (DPI), type your own. Calls has a search box for a name, number, date or Missed.
A person's card: numbers are centred, the pencil opens the real contact editor, and Quick replies are only on Calls. The Contacts icon lost its two bars.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes: The home-screen buttons now keep working even if Message+ is not the default texting app. Settings > Home Screen Shortcut has a switch to turn that off.

messageplus_previous.notes: Voice messages and flip-phone videos now play everywhere: voice messages from flip phones (which no tablet or computer could play) and from other phones are turned into a normal audio file, and flip-phone videos into a normal video, before they go to the tablet.

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
